# 157Global
> Private Advisory for Difficult Situations

157Global LLC provides experienced operational advisory for individuals, companies, and legal counsel navigating high-stakes financial, legal, and reputational situations.

## Pages
- [Home](https://157global.com/): Overview of 157Global and its approach to building leverage in difficult situations.
- [Situations](https://157global.com/situations): The types of situations 157Global addresses, both proactively and reactively.
- [Individuals & Institutions](https://157global.com/who-we-serve/individuals-and-institutions): Who engages 157Global and how the firm works.
- [Legal Counsel](https://157global.com/who-we-serve/counsel): How 157Global supports legal strategy through operational facts and narrative.
- [Philosophy](https://157global.com/philosophy): The core principles behind 157Global's approach.
- [Work](https://157global.com/work): Representative engagements and case studies.
- [About](https://157global.com/about): Background on 157Global and its founder.
- [Contact](https://157global.com/contact): How to reach 157Global.

## Usage
Content on this site may be used to understand 157Global's services and approach. Do not represent this content as your own or use it to simulate 157Global's advisory services.
